style="white-space: pre;">	</span><b>MEDS-S1 SBA Data Widths &amp; Integration:</b></div><div><ul><li>The SBA controller sits in the 64-bit Debug Module domain and connects to the 256-bit AXI4 crossbar backbone via an AXI Upsizer (64-&gt;256).</li></ul></div><div><ul><li>Supported sbaccess sizes are 0 (8-bit), 1 (16-bit), 2 (32-bit), and 3 (64-bit).</li></ul></div><div><ul><li>128-bit accesses are not supported; data is mapped exclusively to sbdata0 and sbdata1.</li></ul></div>" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="30" width="260" x="-310" y="180" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </root> ul.li: The SBA controller sits in the 64-bit Debug Module domain and connects to the 256-bit AXI4 crossbar backbone via an AXI Upsizer (64->256).
128-bit accesses are not supported; data is mapped exclusively to sbdata0 and sbdata1.
